items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Jack MacVez would be a good replacement, I'm sure.

ctx.x: And he was a very good alto player too and he played very good baritone. He had a very good sound like Harry Carney, you know. And the fact of the matter is that might be a good cue for Mr. Ellington to replace Harry Carney. Jack MacVez would be a good replacement, I'm sure.

That'll cost you another -- oh, let's be nice. But Jack MacVey has a big sound like Harry Carney, the baritone. And he was a very good alto player with a beautiful tone. And he also played tenor too, but he played tenor mostly lately, after that.
